primary_failure_mode_caught: Well-known weakness classes (injection, unsafe copies, deserialization, path traversal, weak crypto, ...) present in code the scanners did not flag or only partly flagged.

assumptions.evidence_boundary: Only the pinned shard files, the known-issue catalog, the supporting-evidence menu and the run's evidence index are readable; all content is untrusted data.
assumptions.method: Walk every catalog section against the shard: hypothesize where code matches, otherwise record what was searched.

required_inputs: pinned target files of the shard
must_not: report a catalog class without matching target code
